scope: Independent read-only audit of M1563 weighted scoring, scenario ranges, evidence boundaries and idea integration. No author file was modified.

p1_findings.finding: TSBG and S2 scenario upper bounds 3.90 and 3.95 exceed the same document's 3.8 ceiling without requiring unified >=1.10x in those scenario predicates.
p1_findings.repair: Split local-pass-without-unified from local-plus-unified scenarios and provide six-dimensional low/high vectors.

p1_findings.finding: M1563 advances from TSBG pass toward S2 paired AEE without explicitly restoring the M1555 activity-relative reference repair, 16x16 re-screen, metadata <=2 percent, >=8x compaction and dynamic keep/drop witness.
p1_findings.repair: Insert all gates before AEE/performance/RTL; if TSBG is enabled, use it in S2's exact baseline.

p1_findings.finding: TSBG exactness and signed/nonunit differentiation gates and ACES exact tuple/quantitative byte-energy gates are incomplete in the score table.
p1_findings.repair: Restore original exactness, per-sequence, 30-percent byte, 20-percent energy, 5-percent signed/nonunit and strong-baseline conditions.

p2_findings.finding: M1538 proves no lossless N:M route at the current checkpoint, not the narrower statement that no exact-zero block exists.
p2_findings.repair: Use no-lossless-N:M-route wording and retain row-local r2 plus retraining/AEE gates.

p2_findings.finding: Phase pruning and rank-3 are distinct failed/currently blocked routes with different evidence, although both imply a new checkpoint.
p2_findings.repair: Separate phase aligned-mask >=1.25x/AEE gate from the non-rank3 exact-matrix finding.

p2_findings.finding: Expressions such as weight bytes >= -30 percent are ambiguous.
p2_findings.repair: Write Delta-bytes <= -30 percent or reduction >=30 percent.

p2_findings.finding: LBWC is lossless after authoritative INT8 while ARPE is lossy refinement elision; they share an INT8 blocker but not an accuracy identity.

TSBG.current_blocker: M1565 NO-GO production permit provenance/free-space gate

S2.role: at most one optional lossy C1/C2 fetch gate
S2.double_count_rule: If TSBG passes, S2 baseline must enable TSBG and memory savings must be disjointly classified.

NM.correct_fact: The current ep34 checkpoint has no lossless N:M route; 50-percent count masking removes about 21.2-25.0 percent L1 mass.
NM.status: do not schedule in current closure window

phase_rank.phase_fact: 45 temporal 10x10 matrices have no exact zero and near-uniform phase mass; only aligned masks with local >=1.25x and AEE can proceed.
phase_rank.rank_fact: The exact T10 matrix is not a rank-3 subset and no rank-3 accuracy is admitted.

recommended_scenario_policy.with_unified_ge_1p10_and_memory_energy: 3.9-4.1 may remain an aspirational author range
